title: ToleMetri — Psychological Instrument Adaptation Platform
description: Developing a platform to structure instrument adaptation workflows based on International Test Commission guidelines. Integrates translation, expert reviews, content-validity calculations, item versioning, and documentation through AI-assisted development; currently undergoing internal testing.

title: Ecolit — Research Analysis and Reporting
description: Developed R scripts and an integrated analytical workflow for a Faculty of Psychology, Universitas Padjadjaran study involving 704 participants. Automated analyses and report generation, created data visualisations, and published the outputs as a web-based research report.

title: Creating Shared Value: Jepara Circular - Transforming Wood Industry Waste into a Strategic Business Line for PT. Coco Riki International
description: “Jepara Circular” is a Creating Shared Value (CSV) initiative proposed for PT. Coco Riki International that transforms wood waste from Jepara’s furniture industry into value-added wood briquettes. The project aims to create a new business opportunity for the company while empowering local communities, reducing wood waste pollution, and strengthening a more sustainable local supply chain.

title: Policy Brief: Menuju Penggunaan WiFi Kampus yang Bijak
description: This policy brief recommends restricting access to non-academic digital content, such as mindless social media scrolling, on the campus WiFi network to promote digital sustainability and academic productivity.

title: Seperempat Asa Dibalik Angka: Refleksi Kolektif Menuju Pendidikan Magister Yang Sejahtera
description: This policy brief outlines strategies for curriculum governance and academic calendar synchronization to reduce the high prevalence of stress symptoms (23.8%) among master's students at Universitas Padjadjaran, aligning FIBAA standards with mental well-being.

title: Master's Thesis (M.Psi.)
description: Investigated the moderating role of student engagement in environmental organizations on the link between climate change skepticism and pro-environmental behavior. Methods: Confirmatory Factor Analysis (CFA) & Linear Regression. Tools: Jamovi, RStudio.

title: Competency-Based HRM System Design
description: An academic coursework project applying job analysis, behavioural event interviews, BARS, KPIs, and the ADDIE model to design a competency-based HRM system for barista roles.

title: The Boundary Conditions of Climate Change Skepticism
description: This manuscript in preparation explores the boundary conditions of climate change skepticism, specifically examining how student engagement can moderate the link to environmental activism behavior.

title: Adaptation and Validation of the Environmental Cynicism Scale
description: Published in Jurnal Ecopsy, this collaborative research details the process of adapting and validating the Indonesian version of the Environmental Cynicism Scale, ensuring its psychometric reliability and validity for local contexts.

title: Re-examining the Role of Environmental Cynicism
description: This publication in Jurnal Psikologi Perseptual re-examines the role of environmental cynicism and its direct impact on pro-environmental behavior among university students in Indonesia.

title: Pro-environmental Behavior among Coffee Farmers
description: Co-authored and published in Jurnal Ecopsy, this study investigates the psychological drivers and pro-environmental behaviors specifically within the demographic of coffee farmers in the Muria Mountains area.
